_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Uyini Muteri {player_id} eka Tic Tac Toe ya Vatswari vatatu.
Simbolo yakwe ni '{symbol}'.
Uyisi swiviko swakwe ku chela simbolo yakwe eka bhoza ra 5x5 ku endla moya wa swiviko swa mina.
Miyelo iyona ina fanele ku va ya horisontali, va tikukulu, kumbe diagonal.
Nyika swiviko swakwe hi ku ringana na '[4]' ku chela seli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Fomete ya ku rhurha leyi nga tirhiki. Tirhisa "[cell]" laha sele yi nga 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nomboro ya seli yi ngati: {cell}. Ina fanele ku va kwalomu 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Mutlangi {player_id} u endle ku famba loku nga riki enawini

game_action.placed: Muteri {player_id} u chela simbolo yakwe ({symbol}) eka ndhawu ({row}, {col}).

outcome.draw: Ntlangu wu ve na ku ringana!
